Retire pending execution once at each fluid/soft-body, rope/soft-body and rope/cloth constructor before CPU geometry/attachment traversal. Services.wait_idle may be device-wide; these three waits are resource-edit boundaries outside fixed ticks.

Snapshot all live fluid counts together before public hit-box query launches, retaining the host destinations through transfer completion even on error; use immutable counts until the existing final query completion.
